intro: Deino is a Darkspear troll mage trainer dwelling within the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. Alongside her fellow practitioners, she teaches emerging arcanists how to master the arcane and harness volatile elemental forces. She also directs seasoned spellcasters across Kalimdor to unravel ancient magical anomalies and seek out reclusive tutors.

p: Standing amidst the totems, huts, and tranquil waters of the Valley of Spirits, Deino offers instruction to Horde mages who find themselves in the orcish capital. Troll spellcasters traditionally walk a fine line between spiritual reverence and pure arcane mastery, and Deino represents this unique path within the Darkspear tribe, standing shoulder to shoulder with fellow instructors Enyo and Pephredo.

Beyond fundamental spell craft, Deino tasks promising spellcasters with field research far beyond Durotar's red dust. She sends practitioners northward into the corrupted wilds of Ashenvale to gather the tainted Waters of Xavian and recover enchanted hair from the Laughing Sisters. When a student's power outgrows what Orgrimmar can offer, Deino points them toward remote masters, such as the hermit sorceress Tabetha in the swamplands of Dustwallow.
